title: SQL on FHIR benchmark checkfile schema
description: Committed build-time lock/checksum artifact. Home for everything GENERATED about a benchmark's dataset and expected results (as distinct from the authored benchmark file): dataset identity, generator version, per-size resource counts, per-file sha256 checksums, and the per-case per-size result assertions moved out of the benchmark file.

dataset.description: Dataset identity this checkfile locks; matches the benchmark file's dataset.name/dataset.version.

syntheaVersion.description: Optional generator version actually used to produce the locked data. Present for synthea-generated datasets; a non-synthea dataset may omit it.

resourceCounts.description: Map from each kept resource type to its NDJSON row count at this size.

files.description: Per-file sha256 checksums, one per materialized <ResourceType>.ndjson at this size.

assertions.description: Expected output row count per case, keyed by case id then by size. The former inline expectCount, moved here.
